question: In medicine, ______ is a device such as a small metal plate or needle that carries electricity from an instrument to a patient for treatment or surgery.
solution:
The correct answer is __**An Electrode.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In medicine, an electrode is a device such as a small metal plate or needle that carries electricity from an instrument to the patient for treatment or surgery.
 
• Electrodes can also carry electrical signals from muscles, brain, heart, skin or other body parts to recording devices to help diagnose certain conditions
 
• Electrodes transfer the ionic current energy into electrical current in the body.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **An Electrolyte**__

 __
 
• Electrolytes are minerals in your blood and other body fluids that carry an electric charge.
 
• Electrolytes affect how your body functions in many ways including The amount of water in your body, The acidity of your blood(pH).
 
 
 
• **Venturimeter**__
 __
 
• It is a device for measuring the flow through vessels.
 
• It converts pressure energy into kinetic energy.
 
 
 
• **Machmeter**__
 
 
• It is an airspeed indicator calibrated to read Mach number directly.
